Amazing!  So yummy and simple to make!  Added more strawberry puree to the frosting...otherwise DELICIOUS!!

These were so yummy! I made these for my daughter's 1st birthday party and topped them with a strawberry cream cheese frosting I improvised. Next time I might try substituting half of the butter for cream cheese in this frosting recipe for just a bit of an over the top taste!  I used thawed frozen strawberries instead of fresh since they are out of season.  I also added more strawberry puree and some chopped strawberries to my batter as I wanted a really strawberry flavored cupcake.

I changed the recipe by adding 3/4 c sugar, instead of the 1c. and grating the zest of half a med. lemon. Also, instead of vanilla extract I scrapped the seeds of a vanilla bean. I followed with a strawberry frosting (1/2 stick butter, 1 1/2 c powdered sugar and 2 mashed up strawberries). It was divine!!!
I only made the frosting to top chocolate cupcakes..  Added some meringue powder to make it a little stiffer.  The frosting was a huge hit.  It had a very distinct strawberry flavor.
They were a bit dry.  Too much flour maybe?
DELICIOUS & Easy to make!  People request these from me all the time!
Insanely delicious!!  Very impressed. It's a keeper!!

Made these twice. The first time I really messed it up by using margarine instead of real butter in the recipe. The icing tasted good but was runny. The cake as well. This time I followed the recipe and directions exactly. They were amazing. I also made a filling by mixing some icing with chopped strawberries. It tasted so much better that way.
Yummy, fresh....use more purée and chop strawberries finely for cupcake (adds moisture) and frosting.  Cut powder sugar to 1.5 cups.  Used vanilla bean and all organic ingredients.

After reading the rave reviews, I was disappointed.  The predominant flavor is butter, which is not necessarily a bad thing, except when you want them to taste like strawberry.  The frosting actually tastes a little more strawberry than the cake. I will keep searching for a strawberry cake recipe, this one is not a keeper in my opinion.
I normally don't do anything other than chocolate, but these strawberry cupcakes were awesome.
These were soooooooo yummy and super easy to make we just used mascerated strawberries for

Delicious, Yes. Sweet and great strawberry flavor. BUT... Extremely heavy cake. The minute I took them out of the cupcake pan I felt how heavy they were. Super dense bread like texture when you bite into it. But like I said, very tasty. I'll keep searching for the perfect fluffy strawberry cake recipe. :)

So delicious - even with a few changes - cutting butter back to 1/2 cup and swapping half of the sugar for agave nectar. The taste of fresh strawberries really came through. The frosting was perfect -  pink, luscious swirls that stayed in place even hours later when served to my supper club. Enjoyed by all.

I made a batch of these with fresh strawberries fro the garden. These were delicious. I added chopped strawberries in addition to the puree and they turned out beautifully. Icing is really yummy too. Great presentation with strawberry halves on top. Thanks
Worst cupcake recipe ever. I decided to make these for my sisters birthday, Never again. Tastes like booty. Don't trust the five stars.??

I own a small sweet shoppe in Florida and these are my "go to" cupcakes. They are delicious and beautiful! My customers love them! I pipe the frosting so I cut the frosting recipe in half, if not I have way too much!
It turned out horrible! It couldn't get out of the cupcake liner. The taste was very bad, my friend and I spit it our immediatly. I strongly do not recomend it. We ended up throwing it out!

The cupcake tasted like a strawberry muffin. Not a bad thing but not great. The icing was very strawberry-y but so so so sweet. Almost too sweet in comparison to the cupcake (muffin). I'm so surprised to see so many great reviews. I'm pretty competent in the kitchen so I don't think I did anything wrong. I won't be making these again.
There is not enough strawberry flavor and the frosting broke. i do not recommend. it is very fluffy although

Personally both my family and I enjoyed these. They cupcake wasn't overly sweet. Personally I prefer it that way. I had way too much icing though. I am going to make this into a cake today and see how it turns out.

wah!!! I think this is the best cake which will be the best for my birthday.On my this birthday I will prefer this cake. Thanks alot!!! On Last birthday i got such superb!!! cake from the site : http://www.cakengifts.in/cake-delivery-in-gurgaon

I wasn't thrilled with the flavor of the cupcake, it was more like a muffin, and not a very good one at that. The frosting was delicious though! I added a touch of red food coloring to the frosting to get a nice light pink.

oh man! these cookies were great and so much fun to make! my husband LOVED them! the chocolate on top was a great addition! proportions were perfect and the flavor was addicting! Im definitely gonna add this to my list of favorite gluten-free products!

These are my go-to PB cookies - for Christmas trays, anytime I need to make a treat for a friend with Celiac's, when I need a PC cookie fix...YUM. <br/><br/>I can't believe more people haven't rated these, they're GREAT!

I tried this in my ongoing effort to add more fish to my family's diet. It worked for us because there is no noticeable flavor of fish. I had jumbo eggs, so I needed to add a little more dry crumbs to the mix. I will definitely be using this recipe over and over!
Edited to Add...we love this recipe even more formed into small "meatballs"...they're awesome served with mac and cheese!

This is very quick to put together. I did add quite a bit more wine after adding the cream since it got very thick. It was quite plain so I added a bit of cajun seasoning.
Love the crunch of the pecans.
IMO this would not serve 6 sauce wise. I used maybe 3 ounces of linquine and there was just enough sauce with the added wine.
Made for PAC Fall 2009

Did the brisket as stated and it was WONDERFUL!!
I did the vegetables as you suggested in Recipe#360342
And will never do them any other way again.

I hope you will correct the recipe for others who might want to try it. Thanks for a delicious dinner.
I loved the taste but my ricotta had a very grainy texture without some cream cheese to smooth it out. The Amaretto is certainly a nice touch. Thanks for sharing your recipe.

I thought this was wonderful!  The texture of the ricotta did not put me off at all really.  The Amaretto and almond extract really enhanced the flavor nicely.  It tasted quite decadent, but still low calorie.  BF loved it too.  My blueberries and strawberries were very sweet, but the raspberries I used were not the best:(  No matter.  I thought the measurements and flavorings were very well thought out, and the ratio of fruit to ricotta was perfect.  I added one tablespoon of real sugar to the fruit and subbed 1/2 tablespoon Splenda for the real sugar in the ricotta mix.  I let the berries sit for an hour, which caused some additional liquid to form.  I layered the ricotta mixture in between two layers of fruit.  Very pretty, very tasty.  Excellent for a dinner party!  Thank you for the recipe, Maito:D

I was trying to make this exactly as listed until I realised my ricotta cheese had gone bad so I had to ad lib and ended up using low fat greek yogurt instead. I liked it so much this way that I've had it with yogurt again since, although when I will make it as directed as soon as I get some more ricotta in. What I love most about this recipe is that it is so healthy but tastes to decadent! The only amendment I made the second time was to omit the almond extract. Although it's extract I always (not just in this recipe) find the flavour a bit processed and overpowering. So anyway, I added some more amaretto to compensate! As another reviewer mentioned, the amaretto is a fantastic addition and adds so much depth to the flavour of everything. I didn't serve mine up as beatifully as the photographers did - mine got flung in a tupperware dish and taken to work, but everyone still ooh'ed and aah'ed over it anyway! This is a great recipe though and a definite keeper - it's so easy to make and so lovely and tasty and healthy! Thanks Maito!

Wow, this is a very tasty way of making rice pudding!
It has a lovely brown top and a delicate rice and milk flavour. Mmmm! I could not locate quince paste anywhere near here, so I just threw in some raisins, which was nice, too. The fruity taste went really well with the creamed rice.
The preparation was easy and everything worked out beautifully. Mine was ready after 1 hour and ten minutes. In order to prevent it from browning too much, I covered it with baking paper after 50 minutes.
Its just that I found it to be quite eggy in taste, which is why Im not giving the full 5 stars. Perhaps thats cause Im used to stove top rice pudding without any eggs at all...
Nevertheless, this is great and also very impressive in its presentation. Definitely good for serving to guests.
THANK YOU VERY MUCH for sharing this lovely recipe with us, JustJanS!
Made and reviewed for group 9-Hakea in the Aussie/NZ Recipe Swap #32 September 09.

I love this!  The almond flavor is superior!  I used my homemade ricotta and my stick blender to smooth it out.  It got quite airy and smooth and combined beautifully with the berries.  Lovely, Maito!

I love this healthy dessert. The amaretto really makes this special. Thanks, Maito, for a nice alternative, I actually prefer this to berries and cream!
Update:  this is also really great on waffles for breakfast!

Lovely dessert and no guilt trips.  I've sourced frozen blueberries and have bought bags of them to have on hand and was very glad to use them in this delightful and light recipe.  The perfume of the Amaretto comes through subtly but effectively and should not be left out.

A lovely and refreshing dessert.  I increased the amount of strawberries as I didn't have raspberries.  For the low-fat ricotta, I used low-fat cottage cheese which was blended in the blender.  This is light and delicious.  Made for *ZWT 4*

What a great way to use fresh berries!  The almond flavor really stood out.  I didn't have any raspberries, but the blueberries I picked this morning and fresh organic strawberries were perfect for us.

My neighbor made this for dessert tonight and shared....lucky me! It is SO good. Fresh blueberries that we picked together this morning, lovely strawberries....just no raspberries around. Perfect light dessert. Healthy and felt very adult though I know the kids would dig into this too. I would serve this for company feeling confident it would be loved and loving that it was quick to make. Thanks for sharing! ZWT4 Italy.

OH BOY did we delight in this wonderful dessert dish. Added a little more amaretto and a tad more sugar into the ricotta but honestly it was just perfect! Luckily I had strawberries, blueberries and raspberries. Not a bit was left! Thank you so much! ZWT4 Babes in Italy.
We loved this! I increased the fruit and also added blackberries to the mix. I skipped the amaretto - delish! Thanks for sharing this keeper which we will be having again this summer!

wow this is great.  I used only blackberries.  But I'll try with other fruits another time.  The ricotta mixture is so good that after I ate my serving (on the photo), I did more ricotta but to eat like that alone without fruits.  I used more amaretto.  Yummy!  Thanks Maito :)
Nice healthy alternative.  I think I would prefer mine more with yogurt, but the ricotta was a nice change.  I blended mine to be smoother.  I'll make this again.
I love this! It's low in calories and really good. Frozen mixed berries were used to prepare this. It'll be even better when fresh berries are back in season. Made for PRMR Holiday Special

I made this for an Italian dinner party, and it was a big hit. Since berries are out of season, I made them with frozen (from Trader Joe's) and it was still quite good. Also, instead of chopping the frozen strawberries, I put them in a blender along with the lemon juice and sugar, which created a nice texture. Lastly, I used full-fat ricotta, because that's all I could find, and next time I might use half mascarpone. Oh, and the leftover fruit sauce is great with yogurt for breakfast. :)

This was a perfect ending for our "Girls Martini Night" .  I served it in large wine goblets with the cookie like other reciewers did...I added a titch of whipped heavy cream to make it alittle more richer and creamier...we loved it...

This was a quick, easy way to make coddled eggs....no waiting for the oven to preheat, no heating up the whole kitchen.  I didn't have heavy cream so I used half and half and a tiny dollop of butter, and it came out delicious.  Thanks for sharing the stove-top technique.
They had this one on the Pillsbury webpage a few years back, and it's awesome!  The family loves it!

This recipe gets 5 big stars from my family!  It was GREAT!  The next time, I may double the recipe.  The only thing I changed was I put in 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce and extra parmesan cheese on top before baking.  Very cheesy and yummy!  Thanks for sharing.  It's a keeper!
Great casserole!  I added lots of veggies for extra nutrition (carrots, green pepper, garlic), extra sauce, and garlic crescents.  Very yummy!

Yum! This recipe's a winner! I followed another reviewers suggestions and used 1 1/4 cups spaghetti sauce and sprinkled extra parmesan cheese on the top, and this was really good, even better than I'd expected! I especially love the cheesy layer in the middle and the special touch that the crescent rolls add to the dish! Thanks for a great recipe!

Very nice recipe. Simple to make, simple ingredients, but a little something different. I too added extra sauce....probably 1 1/2+ cups of sauce. Otherwise, I followed the recipe as directed. Nice dinner with a salad and some good bread.
This was a big hit around here, and I loved how easy it was to put together.  Thanks for posting!
This was a hit at mt house, easy to put together too!!
Quick, Easy, but yet sooo good!  Thanks

VERY GOOD!!! Whole Family Enjoyed! I added a few things, I added a layer of pasta after the meat, and Used extra cheese and sauce. I also used the Pilsbury Garlic & Butter Crescent rolls. THis Was VERY Good, Making is a 2nd time already! Thank you!
This is so easy to put together and it's very good.  I will definitely be adding this to my rotation!  Thanks.

This was a really great "comfort food".  I normally don't like to read reviews that alter recipes drastically, but I did want to state that I added some Italion Seasoning and green pepper to the meat/onion mix as it cooked in the slillet.  Other than that, I followed the recipe exactly and it was very yummy!

Loved this!  I took this to one of our family gatherings and it went over well.  I made just a few changes as I used 1 1/4 pounds of ground beef, and 2 cups of spaghetti sauce.  I also topped the ground beef with sliced pepperoni.  Yum!  Will be making this again.  Thanks for sharing.
We really enjoyed an Italian casserole that didn't require pasta! It was a very good dish. I added 2 cloves of garlic to the beef and onion mixture, as that's our favorite. Thanks so much!

This was fantastic!  I used 1 1/4 lbs of ground beef and also used 2 cups of spaghetti sauce.  I used a little extra cheese and sour cream too.  Love how easy this was and we will be having it alot from now on!!!!
Mmmmmm! This was wonderful. I added fresh sauted Mushrooms to the Hamburger mixture. It was a nice addition. Hubby thought it tasted like Pizza. I will definitely make this again.

We thought this was OK.  DH bought the store brand crescent rolls and they were butter flavored. DS said it tasted like a pizza pocket. It is not something that I would make for an adults only crowd. Thanks for sharing your recipe Bamabelle!
This was great, I cannot tell you how much my family enjoyed this

Yummy we loved it super easy and quick to make. The crescents turn out like a flaky pastry so good. I only added s&p,garlic & green peppers to meat I used xtra lean ground beef so i added an extra half cup of sauce you will know if you need extra sauce. This recipe is so interchangable to suit any mood you could add vegtables,potatoes,pasta.You could even add some cottage cheese to the mozzarella mixture to get a thicker cheese layer. What a fun recipe Thanks!

My boyfriend is far from picky, but it is rare that he EVER raves about food. He wouldn't shut up about this casserole, except when he was taking another bite! We both really enjoyed it - good flavor, easy to make, and tasted close to lasagne. Only change was that I added garlic to the meat and onions as they were cooking. Great recipe!

This was very good! Only I had to make an adjustment. I thought I had spaghetti sauce and I didn't so I substituted a can of tomato sauce and added oregano, basil and some thyme. It was loved by every family member which is amazing so I will make this again and try the spaghetti sauce!

Very good, though to be honest, I simply transferred the crescent topping idea to a batch of sloppy joes made with a seasoning packet, tomato paste, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, Hungarian paprika, a pinch of salt and pepper, and between 1/2 to a 1 cup of brown sugar.  The hubbie absolutely loved this!  The concept is a great one--transferrable  :-)
I fixed this sometime ago, and followed the recipe.  Thank you for posting a wonderful dish.  My DH and I thoroughly enjoyed it.  It is definitely a "do again".  Thanks again.

This was so easy and pretty tasty.  Warmed up fine, too.  We always keep ground beef cooked with onion in the freezer, so dishes like this turn out even easier.  I did add a bit of Italian seasoning and garlic to my meat as it was warming up, as some others suggested.  The only thing I didn't care for was the butter with the parmasan cheese.  It didn't spread well and the clumps of it on top just didn't work for me.  I may try melting some butter and then shaking on some cheese next time instead of mixing them together.
Easy to make with common ingredients and turned out great. Made no substitutions. Will make again.

This has always been a favorite of mine!  The first time I tried this was at a friend's house, and her mom made it for my family when we were visiting.  We all loved it so much that my dad asked my mom to get the recipe.  Now, I make it for my own family, and we all enjoy it.

This casserole was very easy to make.  It tasted pretty good too...it seemed like it was missing something, though im not exactly sure what.  I may make this again and if I do im going to add some spices or maybe some red pepper flakes or something. Thanks for posting!

I made this for my family tonight and all of them wanted seconds.

I got my recipe off of the Pillsbury website under their hall of fame category but this is exactly the same recipe and worth making.
Quick and easy, liked by kids and adults.  I wouldn't make it all the time, but it's nice for a speedy meal.

This casserole was very cheesy and easy to make.  The only thing I would change is to probably double the spaghetti sauce because the meat was somewhat bland.  I may add some garlic to this to spice it up a bit too.  Extremely easy and quick though.  I will remake with a few alterations.

I love that this is quick and easy and the flavor is delicious. I think what it is missing is some pasta, though! The next time I think I would mix some cooked mini-penne pasta or even macaroni. It just tasted like there should be something else with the meat mixture. The sour cream and mozzarella cheese combination tasted like ricotta cheese so this dish  has a taste similar to lasagna without all the work. I had to bake mine for 25 minutes to make sure the crescent roll topping was cooked through. I initially found this recipe in the Better Home and Gardens Biggest Book of Italian Recipes. Thanks for posting!

This was a great and easy dish.  I didn't have mozzarella cheese, so I used cheddar and it turned out good.  I also melted the butter before mixing with parmesan and then spread on the casserole.  I used quite a bit more sauce, 1 cup just wasn't enough for our family.  All in all a good, flavorful easy meal!!  Will be making again!
very yummy! made it twice now. I add a chopped garlic clove to the meat as well. Great!
Very good!  I have made this several  times and my fam loves it.  I add minced garlic in the meat as well.

This was great - easy, fast, and tasty!  I really liked that it was creamy and cheesy and the rolls on top made it taste so buttery.  YUM!  The only change I made was to add in 1 clove minced garlic with the beef & onion and season that with salt, pepper, & garlic powder (we're garlic lovers!).  Will make again for sure. UPDATE:  made this again with 1/2 lb ground beef & 1/2 lb italian sausage.  Added even more flavor to this!

We loved this.  It was so quick and easy to make.  Only changes I made was to use 1/3 cup more spaghetti sauce, added garlic, and melted the butter and brushed the crescent rolls with the melted butter then sprinkled with the parm cheese.  I've already gone back for an after dinner piece!  I'll make this one over and over!

My family really enjoyed this recipe
Bamabelle. I liked it because it was quick and easy to prepare and tasted wonderful. I will be making this again and again. Thanks Bamabelle.

Quick, easy, and good.  I substituted vegetarian grounds for the beef, and it worked fine.  I had to cook it about 10 extra minutes to cook the crescent rolls all the way through, but when it was done it was very tasty!
Loved it!!!!! Thanks for such an easy recipe that tastes great.

Fantastic!! Had to leave it in the oven a little longer. Used 2% cheeses and reduced fat sour cream. Left out the butter. Added italian seasoning to the meat mixture. Definately a make again meal. There were no leftovers!!!

Delicious!  This is a keeper!  I added a few things to the ground beef...a little Italian seasoning, green pepper, oregano and garlic.  The spaghetti sauce I used was Hunts good ol' plain spaghetti sauce, so I thought it needed a little extra seasoning.  Otherwise I made this exactly as is.  My DH compared the sauce to his grandmothers!  This was a fabulous recipe and will be a staple in our house.  Thanks so much for posting!
This recipe had a little too much sour cream for our tastes but was otherwise very good.
This is great. I used about 1/2 the sour cream because my husband doesn't care for creamy dishes, and it turned out wonderful. Easy, and feeds a crowd.

This recipe was amazing! I was a little skeptical with the sour cream, but it was wonderful. I had 2 servings! :o) I cooked mine for 18 minutes, and I had to put it back in the oven for another 5 minutes because the butter made the top of the cresent rolls a bit soggy. The additional 5 minutes was exactly what it needed! Thank you so much for sharing! I will definitely keep this recipe on hand! Thank you!!

I'm mixed on this one.  It was a little bland, but I do think with modifications it will be better next time.    I added more spaghetti sauce than called for as other reviewers indicated (1-1/2 cups), but mine was a tad runny as a result.  I also added more cheese "just because" (a mozarella / provolone blend) and it was definitely too much.  The meat / spaghetti sauce did need more seasoning, so next time I will definitely add italian seasoning as someone else mentioned.  It was a pretty dish, though.....I'll definitely try it again, and scale back the sauce & the cheese.

My wife and I tried this one because we had all the ingredients, so we thought. Somehow we missed the sour cream and realized we didnt have any. So in a crazy effort to continue making this, we mixed cream cheese with a little milk then added the cheese. I know it sounds weird but it accutally worked. My wife and I seem to think its better this way.This was an extremely easy and very tasty meal. I wasnt sure what we were going to get but we were pleasently suprised. One thing I did do is season the meat while browning with pepper, garlic powder and salt then added green pepper. I will make this again and will recommend this to someone.

This recipe tasted great! I made a few adjustments and additions. I added 8 oz of mushrooms & 2 tsp of Tastfully Simple Season Salt to the hamburger mixture.  Inceased the sauce to 1 3/4 cup, the mozarella to 2 cups and the sour creams to 3/4 cup.  The crescent rolls did not "puff up" like I thought they would. All in all a quick dinner!! Served with seasoned green beans. Thanks

Made this for dinner and everyone loved it. I doubled the spaghetti sauce and mozarella sauce and used 3/4 cups sour cream. I also added some oregano and italian seasoning to the meat and sauce. This was a quick easy meal that will be used again. Thanks bamabelle.

Loved this!  The whole family made this together and we actually got my daughter to eat it.  She is a picky eater at this young age (5) so we are encouraging her to cook so she will try things.  She loved this!!  All of the ingredients go together so well and this is a very QUICK and EASY recipe.
Very Good!!!  Everyone really liked it.

It was quite good, I loved the parmesan cheese and butter on the top.  I think I would add some mushrooms and peppers to the ground beef mixture.
Thanks,

This was a great mid-week meal!  Added a salad and good to go.  I always seem to have a cup or so of leftover sauce when I make spaghetti (Recipe# 324856) and this was an ideal use for it.  I used 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 sauce as I thought 1 cup too skimpy.  Don't see how it would serve eight as written; would need to double it in my opinion.
This was a nice, simple meal to make and my family loved it.  I also added garlic and some seasonings to my ground beef, but otherwise did the recipe as written.  Thanks!  It's a keeper.
This was a really good easy recipe. I added twice as much sauce and sour cream cheese mixture. I think this is more like 4-6 servings with out the additional sauce. Super easy and good. Thanks!

Just made this for dinner tonight and it was so delcious!!  The recipe says it serves 8, but between my husband, myself, and our 3 year old, we ate almost the whole thing!  Everyone had seconds, which is sometimes rare with a somewhat picky little girl.  There will most definitely be a fit over the leftovers tomorrow.  Thanks for sharing this delicious and easy recipe!

Really good & cheesy :)
Thanks for posting

Yummy and nice and cheesy! This was just a nice easy cheesy dish that the whole family enjoyed. I think next time I might add some sliced green peppers. I will be making this often.  Thank you for posting.
Very good and EXTREMELY EASY!!!  Easy to throw together for a quick homecooked meal!

WOW! This is great stuff! I lightened the recipe up a bit and used ground turkey and low-fat cheeses, sour cream, and crescent rolls - and this STILL was a ZAAR STAR! DH absolutely loved it and is already asking for it again. I took the leftovers for a work lunch today and thought it was even yummier. Thanks for sharing -- will make this again & again!
Delicious! I used ground hot italian sausage and it was TO DIE for!

So so good!!! I did add garlic to the meat mix. I also added mac and shells to the dish (like the others did). To add a little more spice I also added pepper jack cheese. I used the butter cresents and added garlic butter on top of them with the parmesan. Will for sure be making this one again! We loved it!!

My son's LOVE this recipe.  It's always gone in no time, and its easy and inexpensive.  I have found that the crescent rolls have enough fat in them that I only need to dust the top with parmesan cheese, not mix it with butter.

This was very tasty.  My topping turned out just a touch doughy, even though it was in the full 20 minutes.  The top was starting to get a bit dark so I had to take it out.  Next time I'll lower the oven temp to 350 and bake it for 30 min.  Still very tasty and I'll definately make it again.

This has become one of my "go to" recipes. Casseroles do not go over well in our home, so this has been renamed "upside down pizza". Didn't fool my son, but his comment was, "Finally! A casserole I like." I like the versatility of this dish, not to mention the yummy factor. Thanks for posting. You've saved me more than once!
This was excellent, fast and easy. I added fresh mushroom and about an extra 1/2 cup of spaghetti sauce. My husband had two helpings. I cooked mine about 25 minutes.

Very tasty, and many of my family were coming back for second helpings! The only fault I found with this was that it turned out a little sweeter than I was expecting, but that may have been because we used canned sauce for it.
And one other issue was that the cheese mixture came up a little short, but thankfully I had some extra ingredients on hand.
Very tasty, and next time I'll try making it with a different sauce and see how that pans out.
Thanks for the recipe!

We tried this recipe tonight - like others, I was a bit worried about the sour cream thing but it came together wonderfully!  My fiance was also impressed.  I did substitute the Garlic and Butter crescent dough as someone else had suggested and it was awesome.

This came together quickly and was very good!  I lowered the heat (~350) and baked a little longer, to ensure the crescent rolls would not get too dark but would get thoroughly baked as well.  It was good for something different, and using ingredients I already had in the house.  :)

This was good. I used a 9x13 pan because that is the closest size to the one called for. I used more spaghetti sauce that called for since I felt it needed it. I also added 1/3 cup mayo to the cheese and sour cream and increased the sour cream. Both these additions made it more spreadable. Anyone who likes this recipe will also love my Deep Dish Taco Pie Recipe #151806. It is VERY similar to this, only the layering is a little different. Thanks for the post.
This wasn't my favorite but then again I didn't have shredded mozz so I used cubed.  Sure it made a difference.  Would definately use more sauce next time.

This was a nice casserole and very easy to put together. I made it as is but added a little extra sour cream to make it more spreadable. I think next time the only change I will make is using spaghetti sauce with lots of chunky vegetables inside. That will add some sustenance to the meal instead of mainly meat. Thanks for posting!

This was so easy and sooo good!
My kids really loved it!
Thanks so much for posting!

Fantastic!  This was quick to put together and everyone went back for seconds.  I used low-fat versions of most things (lean beef, reduced fat mozzarella, 2% milk sour cream, reduced fat crescent rolls) and it was still rich and delicious.  Based on other reviews I added a little bit of green and red bell pepper and I used a chunky vegetable pasta sauce to get all the food groups in.  I will definitely be making this again in the near future!
Great quick dinner! Kids loved it! I will be making again!! Thanks!

Great and easy! Used ground turkey, seasoned with onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and grated baby carrots, lowfat mozarella, light sour cream, and lowfat crescents - still was fantastic!  I melted the butter and mixed in the garlic powder, then brushed it over top. I am calling it crasagna cause it's like lasagna with crescents instead of pasta!  Very picky DH gave it 5 stars, he had 2 helpings, and took 2 for lunch today.  I will definitely make this again - thanks for sharing!

This was great and super easy to make! I followed the recipe exactly. The only thing I would change is to not mix the butter and parmesan cheese together since the cheese tasted kind of gritty. And I'd probably use a slightly smaller pan since the 9x13 was too big (don't have an 8x12). Maybe I'll try it with a 9x9. The kids loved it and want me to make it again!

This was sooooooo good and really easy to get on the table in a short time.  I was surprised at how tasty it was and I did not have to change a thing.  I used a Tuscan-Style Olive and Garlic spaghetti sauce so that may have been all the extra seasoning it needed, IF it needed any.  Was excellent, I pigged out completely and hubby went back for 2nds as well. Going on my regular rotation so Thanks, I always love regular rotation recipes.
So delicious -- my boyfriend and I renamed it "Upside Down Pizza Casserole." I will be making this again for sure. Thank you!!!

We couldn't figure out what to call this, a pizzagna or a lapizza! It's kind of a mixture of a pizza and lasagna, but not really. 
I will tell you that the mozzarella and sour cream filling is awesome and the recipe is super easy with minimal ingredients. We spent the day working our community's yard sale and were beat, but didn't want to just grab some fast food. This recipe made a nice, hot meal that was delicious, in a very short time. The flavors aren't over powering, so it will appeal to just about any picky eater.

I was skeptical at first because this recipe seemed just too simple, but WOW! My husband inhaled two rather large helpings, and there were NO leftovers. This was quick, easy and inexpensive to make. Thanks so much!
Sorry, but this recipe did not deliver.  When I asked my family, they said this would not be something they would ask for again.
My family raves about this recipe every time I make it. I do add a little Italian seasoning and garlic powder while cooking the meat. Easy to make and easy on the budget too!
It was quick, easy and delicious!  My family loved it!  I think next time I will cut up some italian sausage to make it hardier because my guys love meat!  Great meal!  Thanks

This recipe was fast, easy and DELICIOUS!  Didn't have a full lb of ground beef so just added lots of extra veggies since we love them so much.  Cooked garlic, green and yellow pepper, asparagus and extra onion all with the meat.  Also didn't have quite enough sour cream so for the rest I used a garlic artichoke cracker dip.  I seasoned every layer as I usually do in all my cooking.  I think I might attempt a vegetarian version next time as both my BF and I enjoyed the veggies more than the meat itself. Pretty versatile recipe!

YUM! I love this recipe! My Hubby and kids all went back for more.. So easy! I added all the spices I would if I was making spaghetti and added almost a full jar of my favorite spaghetti sauce (I used 2 lbs gr beef),chopped up some mushrooms and Green Pepper to add to the meat mixture and used Garlic & Butter flavored Crescent rolls. Curious to try a mozzarella/ricotta mixture next time. I will use this one again and again!
We enjoyed the buttery-ness of the crescent rolls with the beef mixture. Really tasty and super easy for a quick dinner after a long day of work.
Thanks so much!  I added more sauce as indicated in other posts and melted in about a handful of spinach.  My husband NEVER eats vegetables and said he liked it!  Banner day at our house!
This was so good and easy to make! Used marinara sauce and it tasted amazing! Only cooked for 18 minutes.
This is a new favorite for us!  The crescent rolls that I had on hand were garlic flavored and it worked out very well.  Couldn't believe how easy it was to make.

Wow is this ever easy!  I got home at 6:15, made this and was eating by 7:15.  This is good, however, I can see that the spaghetti sauce that you use needs to be very flavorful.  Mine was not.  I did add fresh mushrooms and next time I will add alot of spices to the ground beef mixture, as I felt it was a little bland (could be due to the sauce I used).  My husband asked if this was like an upside down pizza, and I agree it has that kind of flavor.  I will fix this again adding more spice and vegies, maybe olives and bell pepper.  But for ease this can't be beat.  Thank you for posting Bamabelle.
Great recipe! I added more sauce & garlic. Super easy and will definitely be sharing this recipe w/my friends. Thanks!
I make this exactly as posted and we really enjoyed it! Thanks for a great recipe for my "keep" file!

This was delicious! I used extra lean ground turkey breast, 1 1/2 cup reduced fat mozzarella cheese, light sour cream and reduced fat crescents to keep this healthy. Even with all the reduced fat ingredients, it was so delicious that even my picky fiancee had two helpings. Next time I make this, I may add some diced green peppers to the meat mixture, use a reduced fat Mexican cheese blend, and add rotel to the meat instead of spaghetti sauce. I think that would be delicious as well! Very versatile recipe and super easy, thanks for posting!

This came out amazing.  I followed directions exactly as stated and it was so easy to make.  My whole family loved it and the leftovers tasted just as good the next day.  I am making again tonight.  Thank you so much for posting recipe.

SUPER YUM, as rated by my husband. Disclaimer on changes: I used ground chicken instead of beef. Also, I added 1/2 cup ricotta and 1/2 cup spinach to the cheese mixture. Another thing I did which added to the appearance is I halved the recipe and made it in a pie dish.

This is delicious!  Hubby's been working late so thought I'd look for a casserole recipe to last us a couple of nights.  This one popped out at me and so glad I tried it.  I used an Arrabiatta (sp?) spaghetti sauce and added mushrooms & a little garlic (because that's just who I am).  We definitely have a keeper and it's easy, too!

Excellent! This tastes great & is super easy! I had to make a few adjustments based on what we had. I used pizza dough rather than the crescent rolls & I also had to use ricotta cheese so I just added a few tablespoons of milk to get it a little thinner like sour cream. I used a jar of pizza sauce rather than the spaghetti sauce, only used a cup of the mozzarella, & added pepperoni to the filling and on top of the crust. I also spiced it up a little with some fresh basil, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper, etc. We had the leftovers tonight and we both agreed that it was even better than the first night, which we didn't think would be possible! Thank you so much for a winner on all counts!

It was ok. My son really liked it. It needed something to mix with all that meat and you had to all but burn the cressent rolls to make sure they were fully cooked underneath.  Its worth a try at least once to see if you like it but I doubt I will make it again.  I also added spinach to the meat mix.

Very good. I did change it up quite a bit but used the main recipe as a core. I added two fresh tomatoes, two cloves of minced garlic, 1/4 chopped green olives, and spinach to the sauce and seasoned with fresh oregano and garlic salt. Added asiago cheese to the topping
Kids loved so I have to give it 5 stars. There are not many dishes that they like but every single one of them said we needed to have this once a week. I loved it too.

This was so quick, easy and flavorful. Of course I doctored up the spaghetti sauce with beef boullion, basil, garlic, celery seed, vinegar. Sorry this will not accept any stars. I will have to imput that later.
This was ok.  It was quick and easy.
Very good recipe.  I made this and we really liked it.  Its a good base recipe and anything can be added with it.  Thank you for sharing with great recipe with us.

This was a great recipe. I followed the advice of other reviewers and seasoned the ground beef with garlic powder and seasoned salt while that and the onions (I used a whole, chopped onion) were cooking. I also used a bit more sour cream to get the cheese mixture to a consistency that I could spread. After seeing the main picture for the casserole, I also added pepperonis to the top before baking. It reminded me of a really wonderful pizza sloppy joe. It got great reviews across the board from our family. The only thing that was misleading was that this was described as "zesty" and I found nothing in the ingredients to create that zestiness. I wound up adding somewhere between 1/4 and 1/2 tsp of crushed red pepper flakes and it turned out great. Thanks for posting! It's a keeper!
This is simple and relatively quick to make! Definitely need to season up the meat for full flavor. Another perfect use for crescent rolls! YUM.
Great dish!  None left!  Will definitely be doing this again!  I've been looking for something similar to stuffed manicotti and this is pretty much it.  Not as expensive.
Tasty, quick recipe for an easy dinner.

This was OK, as written it wouldn't have enough flavor. I made as directed with the exception of using pizza sauce and adding pepperoni. I presented it to my kids as "upside down pizza". I added garlic powder and oregano to the topping (melted the butter before brushing on top) and a lot of seasoning to both the meat and the cheese. It was good, but not over the top amazing that I would anticipate based on the reviews. It is a quick meal when you only have a few things on hand, but they were not ready for a repeat. Thanks for sharing, it's always a challenge finding a recipe that everyone, including the kids enjoy!

The only change I made was to omit salt and pepper, and reduce the olive oil to 3 tablespoons.  The chicken breasts were in the marinade overnight.  This is not too sweet, just a hint.  It's yummy!  Thanks Oolala :)

I was short on time and only marinaded the chicken for about 30 minutes and it still was very flavorful.  I added an additional tablespoon of red vinegar.  After broiling, the syrup gave it a nice crispy caramelized coating.
Just exactly the way I remember it. Thanks!

My husband really enjoyed these beans. I discovered that my crockpot was on the blink. I turned on the crockpot and left for work. When I got home they weren't cooked. So I turned it on low all night, thinking I hadn't turned it on the right setting. The next morning, they were cold so I thought somebody had turned them off. Well after two days of fooling around, I finally switched to a smaller crockpot and they cooked up just fine. I have thrown away the bad one. Thank you so much for posting this. We served it up with yellow rice and chili rellenos. Yum, great meal!
These were really good.  I made them with a ham bone.  I served them with rice one night and stuffed them in flour tortillas another night.  Simple and delicious, it makes a lot!

Nice flavor but I just never could get the beans to cook until they were soft enough for my liking.  I have put them in a pot to boil so hopefully the texture will improve.  Yummy taste though.  I served them with Fat Free Whole Wheat Tortillas #109481 and they went well.  Thanks!
Tasty, easy and healthy - my favorite kind of recipe. I served this with brown rice, sour cream, guacamole and homemade chips. Thank you. It's a keeper !
Super easy and tasty.  My beans took 16 hours to cook but I have an unreliable crockpot and I'm not sure the beans were fresh.  The flavor is great with NO WORK and almost NO MONEY!

This ended up really good, but I had a few problems.  Maybe it was the salsa I used but this was not very flavorful.  I added some taco seasoning, garlic puree, salt and vinegar and it was good, but before those additions it was pretty bland.  I also found that I kept having to add more water and stir the beans because they were sticking to the sides of the crockpot.  So, it's not a recipe that I would want to put in the crockpot and then leave for the day.  I served these on tortillas with sauteed peppers and onions, and a dollop of sour cream.  The end result was very tasty.

MMMmmm... These made great beans for a base for tostadas, burritos, or tacos. I think it would need more flavor to be used as a side dish--maybe garlic, onion, bell pepper, and Tobasco in the last hour or less of cooking. They did stick to the side of the crock pot, but the long cooking made them creamy and soft. I forgot to soak the dried beans all night, so I did the "quick soak" method of boiling for 2 min. and simmering for 1 hour. After my quick soak, my beans only needed 4 hours on low in my 5.5 qt cooker to be fully cooked. I turned the heat to  warm for two more hours and the  beans tasted even better. Thanks for a recipe that will be added to my family favorites!!!

These are fantastic! I only had about  12oz of salsa, so I used that and added 1 teaspoon each of chili powder, cumin, and salt (plus another teaspoon salt after it was cooked). I also put in 6c of water and cooked it on low for 6 hours. So simple, yet delicious! Next time, I think I'll cook them 6.5-7 hours for softer beans (they were cooked but not as soft as I'd have liked) and use less water or just mash some beans for thickening (or do both). Thanks for posting the recipe, Geema!

These couldn't be easier and they're so tasty!

Even with soaking overnight, my beans were still a bit crunchier than I prefer after 10 hours on low, so next time I think I'll either let them go longer or cook them on high. I increased the salsa to 32 ounces and reduced the water; I doubt that had much to do with the long cooking time, but it's worth noting.

Next time around I think I'll toss in some garlic. I'm a wimp when it comes to spicy food, so I used mild salsa and I think garlic will perk up these beans.

Thanks!
Love these beans!  The shallots and balsamic vinegar give the beans a wonderfully savory flavor, without being too tart.  Will make again often!

Made for PAC 2012. What a delicious side dish! And the flavours were so different from what I'm used to with green beans!! I could not find hazels, and used walnuts, like Elisechristiane did. This was a lovely side with a roast chicken, roast sweet peppers, red onion slivers and potato wedges. Thanks, will make this again!!

This recipe is good enough for Thanksgiving and Christmas when only the best comes out. It made a great side with tonight's roast. The hazel nut/green bean combo is a true pleasure. A keeper for sure. Made for PAC, Spring 2014.

Oh my goodness! I have never heard of egg patties, but I totally wish I knew about this recipe like...decades ago! This is SO good!!! The only thing I did was add some minced garlic and a bit of minced ginger when I cooked the tomatoes. I found it a tad difficult to get the potato to seal properly... but it worked out in the end after dipping in the egg and coating in breadcrumbs. These are so delicious!  Served with spicy tomato sauce and DH (as always) ate his patties with bread.

We weren't (sorry that is!) The onions done this way were a perfect topping for the burgers at our Canada Day cookout.  No other condiment was necessary; in fact several people specifically commented what a nice change it was from the mustard, relish & ketchup route. I made up the onions the night before and all that was required at serving time was a few seconds in the microwave.  Very easy, very effective.
Thank you

Okay, repeat after me, using your best Homer Simpson impersonation: "Mmmmmmmmm. Unnnnnnn-yunns." That was me, last night at the dinner table. These are indeed "perfect" and you definitely will not be sorry that you've made them! I served these as a side with our dinner of pierogies and bacon, and was so, so glad I chose this recipe; hubby even took a big second helping which, with onions, is a rarity. I've never done caramelized onions quite this way (never used worcestershire, never covered them up) but this is how I will definitely do them from now on, although I did omit the browning sauce. It was very easy to whip together and, best of all, the final result is absolutely delicious. They held very well in a warm oven, too, while I finished preparing the rest of the meal. Now, "4 large white onions" is kind of a subjective thing, so I used 5 regular onions (size of a tennis ball, which is regular-sized to me), which came out roughly to be 6 cups of thick slices. Next time I'll likely add another onion, too. These onions are all soft and slurpy, and are completely addictive. Thank you so much for posting this recipe!
